title: SM ST5C
text: 带自动电压调节器的离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST5C 静态励磁系统，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator gain, K_R (pu)} 调节器增益、{Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant (first block), T_B1 (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant (first block), T_C1 (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant (second block), T_B2 (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant (second block), T_C2 (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant (first block), T_UB1 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant (first block), T_UC1 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器超前时间常数、{UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant (second block), T_UB2 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant (second block), T_UC2 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器超前时间常数、{OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant (first block), T_OB1 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant (first block), T_OC1 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器超前时间常数、{OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant (second block), T_OB2 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant (second block), T_OC2 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器超前时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器最大输出、{Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器最小输出、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Thyristor bridge firing control equivalent time constant, T_1 (s)} 指定晶闸管桥触发控制的时间常数，按实例取值。
